name: switch-no-unplug
summary: EXPERIMENTAL: input switches between DP and USB-C send only "HPD high" to the new connector (the front-end's switch trigger) instead of an unplug pulse; in DisplayPort Mode 1.4 DSC stays advertised on both connectors
status: hardware-tested 2026-10-08: manual switches DP <-> USB-C in DisplayPort Mode "1.4 without DSC" and 1.4 (DSC): correct picture in 1-2 s, no re-plug on either PC, other monitor undisturbed; main PC re-plugged while USB-C was selected, then DP selected: works. Not yet tested: automatic input, deep-standby wake

edits.asm: sel_hpd / hi_only (linker padding 0x203980): duration 0 -> 0x20 sub 14 (id, 1, 0) only
sub_265A25 front-end path: jal sub_23EE83 -> jal sel_hpd
sub_239618 +0x0E path: jal sub_23EE83 (pulse 650) -> jal hi_only
sub_23979A +0x0E path: jal 0x60 sub 2 (id, 0) -> j 0x239859 (DSC stays advertised)
